author: OmniDom
body: So I just started playing MC again, do the players who had multiple prestige's get anything back, or is it all reset?
body_tagged: So I just started playing MC again, do the players who had multiple prestige's get anything back, or is it all reset?
title: Old levels?

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: Not (everything) is reset, but prestiges are removed and replaced with badges which you pay credits for (from breaking monuments, capturing wools, getting kills, supporting your team, etc.) and you can customize it in the lobby.
